overview: The Hormel Stadium Commission met to review the facility's financial status, discuss spring field grooming and scheduling, and consider proposed locker room painting projects.

items.title: Financial Status
items.summary: The commission reviewed financial reports from the finance office and discussed pending revenue and outstanding user fees.

items.title: Facility Maintenance and Signage
items.summary: Kevin Bailey reported plans to professionally groom the field in early spring and confirmed that updated emergency exit and facility rule signs are in place.

items.title: Spring Field Scheduling and Rental Inquiries
items.summary: Staff reviewed field reservation requests for the upcoming spring season, including Medford High School athletics, Boston Glory, and potential community events.

items.title: Historical Family Outreach Update
items.summary: Phyllis informed the commission that ancestry research is underway to contact family members regarding a city inquiry.

items.title: Locker Room Painting and Upkeep
items.summary: Staff proposed a locker room painting and mural project involving student-athletes, while commissioners noted past concerns regarding flaking ceiling paint.
